Hi Emma / Rajesh —

Great to speak yesterday — quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

- POC goal: Validate Redwood inference latency and monthly cost estimates for your de-identified patient note reranking workflow (10k calls/day target).
- What we agreed: Storix infra will provision a test VPC endpoint and provide a small sample dataset (de-identified). Redwood will spin up the POC stack and run a baseline.
- Current blocker you mentioned: VPN tunnel + internal change freeze on infra team until 10/22.

I can assign one of our "Sherpa" engineers for a 30–45 minute hands-on session to walk through VPC setup and creds. If helpful, we can do the session over remote desktop and get you past the VPN step in one sitting.

Proposed times (PDT): Tue 10/20 10:00–10:45, Wed 10/21 14:00–14:45, Thu 10/22 09:00–09:45. If none of those work, tell me a couple alternatives and I will coordinate.

Attached: poa_checklist.pdf (stub) — minimal checklist for VPC + test data handoff. Also here's the quickstart doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-poc-resources

Next steps: pick a slot or reply with priority update. If your team is deprioritizing the POC, say so and we can pause the environment (no charge) until you’re ready.

Thanks —

Hi Rajesh — quick follow. I haven't seen a slot yet and wanted to check if priority/timing shifted.

Two options if infra stays busy:
1) We can run a remote demo using a synthetic dataset across a secure tunnel on our side (no changes on your infra). Good for validating latency and CPU/GPU sizing.
2) We can do the Sherpa session as proposed and use a temporary test VPC account with strict ACLs — your infra can review after the fact.

I attached a short "Sherpa" playbook (redwood-sherpa-guide.md, stub) that explains what we do during the session and the minimal permissions we request. Also linking SOC2 evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-poc-resources (SOC2 artifacts are in the compliance folder).

If this is no longer a priority, tell me and we can pause the POC and revisit later. Otherwise, pick a time and I'll set it up.

Thanks,
Mateo

- If your timeline slipped, we can pause the POC and keep a snapshot of the environment. Alternatively, we can offer a one-time onboarding credit (covers up to 2 Sherpa hours) as a small incentive to re-schedule this month.
